chars.M: MOHSINE: a man wearing a light blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, dark grey chinos and brown shoes
chars.Z: ZINEB: a woman wearing a cream-coloured hijab and a long olive green trench coat
chars.Y: YASMINE: a young woman wearing a bright red leather jacket over a black top, blue jeans and white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: MOHSINE sits at a café table next to ZINEB, sweating and terrified with wide eyes; YASMINE stands right beside their table staring at him with shock and hands on hips; ZINEB looks up at her suspiciously. Comic awkward tension in a small Moroccan town, café terrace with small metal tables and glasses of mint tea

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: ZINEB happily holds MOHSINE's arm while they walk down a narrow evening street of a small Moroccan town; MOHSINE smiles nervously and glances over his shoulder

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: MOHSINE peeks carefully around a corner into a small Moroccan café before entering, eyes worried, while ZINEB waits behind him looking confused

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: MOHSINE stands in the middle of a tiny Moroccan town square with only two cafés around, hand on his forehead, sweating and anxious; a few people at café tables in the background

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MOHSINE and ZINEB sit together at a café terrace table with glasses of mint tea; ZINEB smiles happily and talks, MOHSINE smiles but looks tense in a small Moroccan town, café terrace with small metal tables and glasses of mint tea

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YASMINE walks past the café terrace and turns her head to stare at MOHSINE and ZINEB sitting at their table; MOHSINE freezes with his tea glass in mid-air; ZINEB turns to look at YASMINE in a small Moroccan town, café terrace with small metal tables and glasses of mint tea

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: ZINEB turns angrily to MOHSINE across the café table, pointing to the side and demanding an answer; MOHSINE is pale, sweating, shrinking in his chair in a small Moroccan town, café terrace with small metal tables and glasses of mint tea

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YASMINE stands at their café table with arms crossed, staring at MOHSINE with hurt and anger; ZINEB stares at YASMINE in shock; MOHSINE sits between them frozen and speechless in a small Moroccan town, café terrace with small metal tables and glasses of mint tea
